annotations.title: Connect Discord, Slack, Telegram, and more

description: Connect the server to a chat: “send deaths to my Discord”, “post joins to Telegram in Russian”. `create` makes one and sends a test message. `update` changes it, or pauses it. `test` works once per webhook every 10 seconds. `telegram_chats` lists the chats a Telegram bot can write to. list_webhooks with options has a `guide` to getting each service's URL or bot token. These are secrets: ask the user to paste them, never invent or repeat them. A webhook sees no coordinates and no chat unless permissions widen that, up to this token's own. Webhooks in config.yml change only there.

messages.description: Own words by message key, such as {"player.death": "RIP: {message}"}

name.description: For create, a new one such as discord-deaths

topics.description: Event ids, such as ["player.death"], ["player.*"], or ["*"] for every notable one
